title: Fediverse followers now see new topics
notes: Federation fix: when someone follows your community from Mastodon or another fediverse server, every new topic now appears in their timeline (the community boosts each topic, with the original author credited). Also includes the 1.42.0 batch: redesigned two-pane direct messages, multilingual search, and theme + category UX improvements.

changelog.text: ActivityPub: community followers now receive new topics in their fediverse timeline (community boosts each member topic; topic URLs are dereferenceable as ActivityPub Notes).
Direct messages redesigned into a two-pane layout.
Theme and category management UX refinements.
